# Town Square Plot 35

> Plot 35 is a cluster of four residential blocks within Town Square, a master-planned community of some 750 acres in Dubailand, Dubai. Each block rises from a ground floor and podium through eleven typical residential levels, with health-club facilities at roof level. The surrounding community offers a central park, jogging and cycling tracks, playgrounds, schools and neighbourhood retail, reached from Al Qudra Road.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Town Square, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Plot 35 is a residential cluster within Nshama's Town Square community in Dubai, made up of four apartment blocks that each rise ground, podium and 11 floors, with health clubs at roof level. MENASCO carried out the MEP works for the buildings, covering HVAC, electrical, plumbing and firefighting systems, with Mimar Engineering Consultants as consultant.
